# Credits

## Pibby Apocalypse Cursor Recreation Script

This cursor set is based on the [Pibby Apocalypse Cursor Recreation Script](https://gamebanana.com/tools/15314) by **[jarekboho](https://gamebanana.com/members/2145650)** (Coder). It provided the 10 cursor frames and the frame-by-frame animation logic.

## Pibby: Apocalypse

The cursor art comes from [Pibby: Apocalypse](https://gamebanana.com/wips/73842), licensed [CC BY-NC 4.0, credited to the Pibby: Apocalypse Team](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). That license means you must give credit, and you may not use the work commercially.
